blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines —A Ramon Magsaysay Awardee has voiced solidarity with Chin survivors seeking justice before local courts in the Philippines against what was described as “continuing Myanmar military atrocities.” Bo Kyi, a human rights defender and former political prisoner in Myanmar, called on Philippine officials on Sunday, Nov. 15, to uphold the rule of law
